card.name: The word best in "at best"
card.fires_on: The word "best" (or "most") right after "at" in hedging phrases like "at best" or "at most", where a limit or weak upper bound is being stated.

modes.label: at best
modes.description: "best" after "at" when the writer gives a generous but weak estimate of something.
modes.example: -war period L was in economic decline, or at<< best>> stagnant.

modes.label: at most / maximum
modes.description: "most" after "at", or words just after it, setting an upper limit.
modes.example: Black carbon particles only remain airborne for weeks at<< most>> compared to carbon dioxide

card.plain: It marks the hedge "at best" or "at most", where the writer is giving the most favorable or highest limit.
